summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would authorise payments needed for Australia to join the African Development Bank and the African Development Fund, including share purchases and subscriptions.
The Minister could purchase 5,912 paid-up and 92,616 callable shares, with a maximum price of 10,000 special drawing rights per share.
The bill would begin the day after Royal Assent, while joining the institutions would also require approvals and completion of the relevant international agreements.
changes: Bank share payments would be authorised from the Consolidated Revenue Fund.
Fund subscriptions would rely on appropriations provided through other legislation.
The Minister could issue securities to make payments to either institution.
Increasing Australia's shareholding beyond the specified shares would require amending the legislation.
summary.affected: The Australian Government, the African Development Bank and the African Development Fund are affected.
